verdict.rationale: Docs confirm machines can be created with a public IP address and an optional private network, and shared drives work across machines on a private network, supporting inter-instance private networking. However, there is no explicit documentation of exposing specific application ports or configuring port-forwarding/firewall rules for serving apps from an instance. missing for 10: explicit port-exposure/firewall configuration docs, independent confirmation of private networking working in practice, and details on serving apps via specific ports.
